Meter.definition: The base unit of length in the International System of Units (SI). Defined by setting the speed of light in vacuum to exactly 299,792,458 m/s.
Meter.history: Originally defined in 1793 as 1/10,000,000 of the distance from the Earth's equator to the North Pole along a meridian through Paris.
Meter.used_for: Room measurements, height, athletic tracks, and scientific spatial dimensions.

Kilometer.definition: A metric unit of length equal to 1,000 meters.

Kilometer.used_for: Geographical distances, road signs, navigation, and endurance sports.

Centimeter.definition: A metric unit of length equal to 1/100th of a meter.
